title: e212: Updating with all currently documented operators
description: While I needed to update 1 operator, I went ahead and dumped all from mcc-mnc.net, and added any 2 and 3 digit PLMNs that were not in here. Any existing ones I did not touch.

notes.body:
How reliable is this website?
As indicated by the dissector name and the comments at the top of the file, the purpose is to list the operators officially registered to ITU. But updating this file is a manual process that is very painful (I did during a few years with the bi monthly releases of updates by ITU).
As the ITU E.212 document is painful with those endless amendments, we might consider to another source of trust if it exists.

I questioned that as well. Using what I had with ITU at first really didn't give me a good formated list (alot of things are locked for me), because I didn't want to do this many by hand. I looked in the header of the this file and it had reference to this mcc-mnc.com site. There was a nice csv list that I very quickly able to script the inserts. So I went with that. Let me know. I can close this if you want, just wanted to help where I could.

```c
* Find the bulletins here: http://www.itu.int/pub/T-SP-OB
 *
 * Amended with information from http://www.mcc-mnc.com
```

To be honest I'm not sure what's the best way to move forward. Anything that can improve the maintenance of this list is more than welcome (as indicated I maintained it during a few years and got tired of this painful process). I'm just wondering what trust we should put in this site. On the other hand the ability to export a CSV is extremely valuable, so if we consider it to be reliable, we could switch to it rather than using a likely obsolete list.
What do other think?

I'm good with the CSV. heck it'd be nice to do something like a host file that is maintained. But allows individuals to edit it in source (like the diameter files) (I always come back to the diameter files don't I ), so that a certain company that has 32 PLMN's could update it to be not just 

310260 \<company\> 

311882 \<company\>

but I could put my own stuff in there like 

310260 \<company secret plmn\>

311882 \<company super secret plmn\>

but then someone would have to have the time to develop that :smile:
We might as well merge this. I think.
If we all agree on this, then it would be great to share your script Mark (eventually in another MR).

Should we ask ITU for a better format to download all registered entries?

I'm not against downloading from mcc-mnc.com, they are probably more up to date than our attempt to fetch from several documents.
Is ok to go ahead and merge this, then revisit it this summer when I see you in person?
Could you update the header to indicate that there was a massive update using mcc-mnc.net?
@pquantin I updated the file header. Let me know if you need anything else.
